description: This source file defines locale-specific messages for the Select2 plugin version 4.0.6-rc.1, specifically for the English language, including error messages, prompts, and labels used within the plugin.

methods.name: errorLoading
methods.description: Returns the message displayed when results cannot be loaded.

methods.name: inputTooLong
methods.description: Returns the message prompting the user to delete excess characters.

methods.name: inputTooShort
methods.description: Returns the message prompting the user to enter more characters.

methods.name: loadingMore
methods.description: Returns the message displayed while more results are being loaded.

methods.name: maximumSelected
methods.description: Returns the message indicating the maximum number of items that can be selected.

methods.name: noResults
methods.description: Returns the message displayed when no search results are found.

methods.name: searching
methods.description: Returns the message displayed during a search operation.
